questions.q: ------- the budget was approved late, the project team finished the renovation on schedule.
questions.why: 後ろに節（S+V）が続くので、節を導ける接続詞 Even though が入る。Despite と Owing to は前置詞で、However は副詞。

questions.q: The museum will remain open ------- the weather becomes severe.
questions.why: 「天候が悪化しない限り開館する」という条件を表す接続詞 unless が適切。ほかは節を直接続けられない。

questions.q: Mr. Tanaka will lead the workshop ------- Ms. Evans is away on a business trip.
questions.why: 後ろに節があるので接続詞 while（～の間）が入る。during は前置詞で名詞しか続けられない。

questions.q: The new software has been installed ------- employees can access the files remotely.
questions.why: 「～できるように」という目的を表す接続詞 so that が入る。in order to の後ろは動詞の原形。

questions.q: Customers will receive a refund ------- the item is returned within thirty days.
questions.why: 「～という条件で」を表す接続詞表現 provided that が入る。ほかは前置詞句で節を取れない。

questions.q: The new parking policy will take effect ------- January 1.
questions.why: 特定の日付の前には前置詞 on を用いる。

questions.q: Ms. Rivera was promoted ------- her outstanding sales performance.
questions.why: 後ろが名詞句なので、前置詞句 because of が入る。because などは接続詞で節が必要。

questions.q: Participants must register ------- the end of this week to receive the discount.
questions.why: 「期限までに」という意味を表すのは by。during は期間を表し、since は起点を表す。

questions.q: The factory is located ------- the river and the main highway.
questions.why: 2つのものの間は between で表す。among は3つ以上のものの間に用いる。

questions.q: The company has operated ------- three decades without a single safety violation.
questions.why: 期間の長さを表す語句の前には for を用いる。since は起点を表す語が必要で、while は接続詞。

questions.q: Only after the inspection was completed ------- the building be reopened to the public.
questions.why: Only after ～ が文頭に来ると倒置が起こる。過去の文脈なので助動詞は could。

questions.q: Rarely ------- such a large number of applications for a single position.
questions.why: 否定の副詞 Rarely が文頭に来ると、疑問文の語順（助動詞＋主語＋過去分詞）になる。

questions.q: Applicants ------- résumés are incomplete will not be considered.
questions.why: 後ろに名詞 résumés があり「その人たちの履歴書」を表すので所有格の関係代名詞 whose。

questions.q: The report, ------- was released on Monday, shows a rise in exports.
questions.why: 先行詞は物（The report）で、後ろに主語がない動詞が続くので主格の which。

questions.q: The board announced a ------- increase in production costs.
questions.why: 冠詞と名詞の間で名詞 increase を修飾するのは形容詞 significant。

questions.q: Ms. Cho was ------- appointed to lead the overseas division.
questions.why: be 動詞と過去分詞の間で動詞を修飾するのは副詞 formally。

questions.q: All invoices must be ------- to the accounting department by the 25th.
questions.why: must be の後ろは受け身の過去分詞。請求書は「提出される」側である。

questions.q: The company plans ------- a new branch in Osaka next year.
questions.why: plan は不定詞（to＋動詞の原形）を目的語に取る。

questions.q: The director asked the new employees to introduce ------- to the team.
questions.why: 主語（新入社員）と目的語が同じ人たちなので再帰代名詞 themselves を用いる。

questions.q: The list of approved vendors ------- posted on the intranet.
questions.why: 主語の中心は単数の The list なので、単数現在形の is が入る。vendors に惑わされない。

questions.q: The two firms announced a ------- that will create the country's largest logistics company.
questions.why: 2社が合わせて最大手の物流会社をつくるという文脈から、「合併」を意味する merger が適切。

questions.q: The audience's ------- for the new product was clear from the long line at the booth.
questions.why: 「新製品への熱意」を表す enthusiasm for ～ が文意に合う。

questions.q: Please treat the client list as ------- and do not share it outside the department.
questions.why: 部外に共有しないよう求める文脈なので、「機密の」を意味する confidential が合う。confident は「自信のある」。

questions.q: The new advertising campaign is designed to ------- to younger customers.
questions.why: appeal to ～ で「～の心に訴える、～に魅力的である」の意味になる。

questions.q: Employees are encouraged to ------- any safety concerns to their supervisors immediately.
questions.why: 安全上の懸念を上司に「報告する」という意味の report が文意に合う。

questions.q: The warranty covers any ------- in materials or workmanship for two years.
questions.why: 保証が対象とするのは材料や作りの「欠陥」。defects が適切。

questions.q: The software update is expected to ------- the speed of the system considerably.
questions.why: システムの速度を「向上させる」という意味の enhance が合う。

questions.q: Ms. Okada was ------- for her leadership during the company's restructuring.
questions.why: リーダーシップを「称賛された」という意味になる commended が適切。

questions.q: The hotel offers a ------- shuttle service between the airport and downtown every thirty minutes.
questions.why: ホテルが提供する「無料の」シャトルサービスという意味の complimentary が自然。

questions.q: As the filing deadline draws -------, the accounting team is working overtime.
questions.why: draw near で「近づく」。補語になるのは形容詞/副詞の near。
has been の後ろには過去分詞が入り、「配送が遅れている」という受け身になる。

c: The desk is available in three colors and two sizes.
Our warehouse is closed on public holidays.
Many customers have praised our assembly instructions.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
questions.why: 配送の遅れを知らせる流れなので、不便をかけたことへのお詫びの文が自然につながる。他の文は話題と合わない。
前置詞 of の後ろで「お詫びのしるし」を表す名詞 apology が入る。
「12月1日までに」という期限を表すので by が入る。
will now open ... and の後ろは助動詞 will に続く動詞の原形なので remain が入る。
冠詞と名詞 survey の間なので、名詞を修飾する形容詞 recent が入る。

c: The library was founded more than a century ago.
Several new magazines have been added to the collection.
Saturday and Sunday hours will remain unchanged.
Parking near the building is limited to two hours.
questions.why: 開館時間の変更の話に続けて、週末の時間は変わらないと補う文が自然。他の文は開館時間と無関係。
「訪問することによって」という手段を表す前置詞 by が入る。
先行詞は The project（物）で、後ろに主語のない動詞が続くので主格の関係代名詞 which が入る。

c: Officials say the path is meant to reduce traffic in the downtown area.
The central station was renovated in 1995.
Ticket prices for the ferry will rise next month.
Ms. Ortiz opened her cafe three years ago.
questions.why: 自転車道の整備計画の説明に続き、その目的を述べる文が自然。他の文は計画と関係がない。
have と過去分詞 waited の間で動詞を修飾する副詞が入る。long は「長い間」の意味の副詞。
特定の日付の前には前置詞 on を用いる。
取引先が新しい包装ラインを「視察する」という意味の inspect が文意に合う。
be 動詞の後ろで be familiar with ～ （～をよく知っている）の形容詞 familiar が入る。

c: The cafeteria will introduce a new dessert menu next month.
Last year's sales figures were higher than expected.
I have been working at the Portland office for ten years.
Our guests will tour the production floor immediately after their arrival.
questions.why: 来客の見学を受けて、作業場を清潔にするよう依頼する流れになる。見学の予定を述べる文が自然。
「訪問者が非公式にチームと会えるように」という目的を表す接続詞 so that が入る。

questions.q: Why did Ms. Nandakumar write the e-mail?
c: To invite clients to a meeting
questions.why: 参加者が増えて今の部屋では狭いので、より広い部屋への変更を頼んでいる。

questions.q: How many more clients than expected will attend the workshop?
questions.why: 当初の予想は12人で、実際は18人。差は6人。

questions.q: What will Ms. Nandakumar do if the Harbor Room is not available?
c: Look for a venue outside the company
Postpone the workshop to the following week
Hold the workshop in Meeting Room 4 anyway
questions.why: ハーバールームが予約済みなら、社外の会場を探すと書いている。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned in the advertisement?
c: Free delivery in a limited area
Online ordering through a mobile app
questions.why: 早期注文の割引、一定範囲の無料配達、食事制限への対応は書かれているが、アプリでの注文には触れていない。

questions.q: A company orders the buffet for 30 people ten days in advance. How much will the meals cost, not including delivery?
questions.why: 22ドル×30人で660ドル。7日以上前の注文なので10％引きとなり594ドル。

questions.q: The word "applies" in the advertisement is closest in meaning to
questions.why: 「距離を超える場合は30ドルの手数料がかかる」という意味で、applies は「課される」に近い。

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
c: The closing of a local factory
A company's plan to expand its operations
A change in the company's management
The opening of a new community center
questions.why: 工場を拡張して120人を採用するという会社の計画を伝える記事。

questions.q: Why is Kessler Fabrics expanding its plant?
c: Orders from furniture makers have increased.
questions.why: 家具メーカーからの注文が増えたことを受けた拡張だと述べている。

questions.q: What is suggested about Kessler Fabrics?
c: It plans to move out of Salton.
It is willing to train inexperienced workers.
It uses automated looms in all of its plants.
questions.why: 経験のない人も歓迎で、研修は現場で行うと書かれているので、未経験者を育てる意思がある。

questions.q: The word "outpaced" in the article is closest in meaning to
questions.why: 需要が現在の建物の対応力を「上回った」という意味で、outpaced は exceeded に近い。

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Whitfield report?
c: The caterer cannot deliver on time.
questions.why: 仕出し業者が翌日の昼食を1時までに届けられないと伝えている。

questions.q: At 2:10 P.M., what does Mr. Reyes mean when he writes, "That would be great"?
c: He approves of the suggestion to use the cafe.
He is pleased the training will start earlier.
He thinks the caterer should be paid more.
He wants to have lunch at the cafe himself.
questions.why: 階下のカフェにサンドイッチを頼むという提案に賛成している。

questions.q: How much will the sandwiches from the cafe cost in total?
questions.why: 1人9ドルで20人分なので180ドル。

questions.q: What is indicated about the invoice?
c: The items were shipped free of charge.
Payment is due on the day of the order.
The customer received a discount for a large order.
The invoice is for office furniture.
questions.why: 500ドルを超える注文に対する5％の大口割引が適用されている。

questions.q: By what date must Harlow & Brandt Associates pay to avoid a late fee?
questions.why: 請求日の10月12日から30日以内なので11月11日が期限。

questions.q: How much was the bulk discount?
questions.why: 小計590ドルの5％で29.50ドル。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
c: To announce a new bonus plan
To ask for volunteers to lead training
To explain a change in how reviews are done
To report the results of reviews
questions.why: 紙の書式からオンライン入力へ、評価の進め方が変わることを説明している。

questions.q: What are department heads asked to do before starting the evaluations?
c: Submit paper forms to Human Resources
questions.why: 評価を始める前に、2回のうちどちらかの研修に出るよう求められている。

questions.q: Why most likely will no extensions be granted?
c: The Staff Portal will close permanently in October.
Training sessions will be unavailable after September.
Employees will be on vacation in November.
Bonus payments depend on the completed reviews.
questions.why: 評価の結果が11月の賞与支払いの基準になるため、期限は延ばせないと説明している。

questions.q: What is mentioned as an advantage for applicants?
questions.why: スペイン語かフランス語ができると有利だと書かれている。

questions.q: How should interested people apply?
c: By calling the human resources department
questions.why: 履歴書とカバーレターをメールで送るよう指示している。

questions.q: Which benefit is NOT listed in the advertisement?
questions.why: 有給休暇、健康保険、旅行券は載っているが、住宅手当は書かれていない。

questions.q: Why was the letter written?
c: To announce the completion of the restoration
To report a change in schedule
To thank a donor and extend an invitation
questions.why: 寄付への感謝を述べ、内覧会への招待を伝えている。

questions.q: How much money has been raised so far?
questions.why: 目標の5万ドルの80％にあたる4万ドル。

questions.q: What is Ms. Alvarez entitled to receive?
c: A free membership in the society
A discount at the mill's shop
A copy of a history book
Her name displayed on a plaque
questions.why: 1,500ドル以上の寄付者は名前が銘板に掲示される。彼女の寄付額は2,000ドルである。

questions.q: What is Ms. Alvarez asked to do by November 6?

questions.why: 11月6日までに、内覧会に出席するかどうかの確認を求められている。

questions.q: Where will lunch be served?
questions.why: 昼食の会場はテラスと書かれている。

c: A person interested in import regulations
questions.why: Session 3 は通関ルールの更新がテーマなので、輸入の規制に関心のある人が参加する。

questions.q: What is indicated about the workshop?
c: It is led by Helena Brandt.
It takes place in the ballroom.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Web page?
c: To announce a new rental location
To describe the benefits of a business rental program
To explain how to return a vehicle
To advertise a sale on used cars
questions.why: 法人アカウントの料金や特典を紹介するページ。

questions.q: What will be Mr. Lindahl's daily rate?
questions.why: 中型車は1日55ドルで、5日以上なので15％引き。55ドルの85％で46.75ドル。

questions.q: What is indicated about adding Ms. Okoye as a driver?
c: It is possible only for SUV rentals.
It must be done in person at the airport.

docs.label: Article
docs.text: HARBOR CITY (March 3) — City officials announced on Tuesday that construction of a 12-kilometer cycling path along the waterfront will begin in April. The project, (1) is expected to cost $8 million, will connect the central station with the Fishermen's Wharf district. (2) Local business owners have welcomed the plan, saying that it will bring more visitors to the area. "We have (3) waited for a safe route for our customers," said cafe owner Linda Ortiz. The path is scheduled to open to the public (4) September 30.

docs.label: Article
docs.text: SALTON (June 18) - Kessler Fabrics, which has produced upholstery materials in Salton for forty years, announced on Monday that it will expand its Riverside plant and hire 120 additional workers over the next two years. The expansion, valued at $15 million, follows a rise in orders from furniture makers in neighboring countries. "Demand has outpaced what our current building can handle," said plant director Daniel Voss. The new section will house automated looms that are expected to reduce energy use by about 20 percent. Hiring will begin in September, and the company plans to hold a job fair at the Salton Community Center on August 9. Mr. Voss added that candidates with no previous textile experience are welcome, as training will be provided on site.

Dana Whitfield [2:05 P.M.]: Omar, the caterer just called. They can't deliver the lunch until 1 P.M. tomorrow.

September 28

Ms. Camila Alvarez
118 Orchard Lane
Eastfield

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

I am writing on behalf of the Eastfield Historical Society to thank you for your generous donation of $2,000 toward the restoration of Calloway Mill. Your gift, together with contributions from more than 300 other residents, brings us to 80 percent of our $50,000 goal.

Restoration work will start in March and is expected to take about eight months. As a donor, you are invited to a private preview of the restored building on the evening of Friday, November 20, before it opens to the public. You may bring one guest. Please confirm by November 6 by calling our office or replying to this letter. Donors who give $1,500 or more will also have their names displayed on a plaque near the main entrance.

Again, thank you for helping us preserve our community's heritage.

Sincerely,
Martin Eide
Director, Eastfield Historical Society

docs.label: Article
docs.text: MIDTOWN (August 12) - Residents of Midtown can now borrow power drills, ladders, and garden tools from the public library, officials announced Wednesday. The Tool Library, located in the library's basement, opens on September 1 with more than 200 items donated by local hardware stores and residents. Borrowers must hold a library card and complete a 15-minute safety orientation. Items may be borrowed for up to seven days, with one renewal if no one else has requested them. Library director Aisha Brandt said the program aims to help residents who cannot afford to buy tools they use only occasionally. Volunteers are still needed to repair donated items; interested persons may register at the front desk through August 28.

VOLTA HOME ANNOUNCES VOLUNTARY RECALL OF MODEL K2 KETTLE

Volta Home announced a voluntary recall of its Model K2 electric kettle sold between March 1 and August 31 after reports that the power base may overheat. No injuries have been reported. Customers who own the K2 (the model number is printed on the base) should stop using it immediately and visit www.voltahome.example/recall to request a replacement or a refund. Replacements ship within 10 business days; refunds are issued within 14 days of receiving the returned base. Kettles with model number K2-B are not affected.
